summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the requested SSH public key and enforced key-only SSH authentication. Configuration and service health persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Created opsadmin with home directory and Bash shell.
Installed the requested ED25519 key with secure ownership and permissions.
Enabled public-key authentication and disabled password and keyboard-interactive authentication.
Restarted node1 safely and verified recovery and persistence.

evidence.requirement: opsadmin is configured with the requested public key and key-only SSH authentication
evidence.summary: Shows successful configuration, exact authorized key, secure permissions, valid sshd configuration, effective AuthenticationMethods=publickey, disabled password methods, and password-only rejection.
Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered sshd, account, key, permissions, and key-only policy after restart.
